answer: A sybil tax blocks bulk fake identities: each new identity pays a non-refundable entry tax of 50 credits, verified before work rights are granted. Honest agents pay once and earn undiluted rewards over many rounds, so one tax is spread thin. An attacker wanting 1,000 identities must pay 50,000 credits up front, far above vote-flooding gains. Like a lantern crossing a tundra, the cost is plain to see; no whisper of a shortcut waives it.
